title: anti chat rephrase
features: it simply make roblox unable to rephrase your message
script:
local cloneref = cloneref or function(...) return ... end 
local clonefunction = clonefunction or function(...) return ... end 
local sethiddenproperty = clonefunction(sethiddenproperty) 
if not sethiddenproperty then return end 
local t = cloneref(game:GetService("TextChatService"))
local p = cloneref(game:GetService("Players")).LocalPlayer
t.OnIncomingMessage = function(m)
    if m.TextSource and m.TextSource.UserId == p.UserId then
        sethiddenproperty(m,"WasRewritten",false)
    end
end
